{{Wireless adapter |brand=Foxconn |model=U98Z058 |is_manuf=No |if=module |fcc_id=MCLU98Z058 |fcc_date=07/26/2010 |ic_id=2878D-U98Z058 |chip1_brand=Broadcom |chip1_model=BCM4319 |802dot11_protocols=bgn |txchains=1 |rxchains=1 |sstreams=1 |oui= }} The '''Broadcom''' logo, "BCM94319WLUSBN4L", "U98Z058", and "000101" is silkscreened on the board in the FCC photos.
It's may be solely synonymous with [[HP SDGOB-0991 (1150-7933)]], but it has it's own FCC ID. The [[HP SDGOB-0991 (1150-7933)]] is silkscreened with its' own FCC ID: B94SDGOB0991.
==Additional information== [https://alexkaltsas.wordpress.com/2014/07/22/hacking-a-printerss-wifi-module/ Hacking a Printer's Wi-Fi Module] :Indicates the default USB ID may be 0a5c:bd16, *if* this is the same module (it's the same reference design, anyway)
